title: Joined in June - received The Clash: London Calling - an essential for every collection
text:
I began the subscription towards the end of June (2nd month of the subscription). I heard about it quite by chance after reading two review articles the week before. I subscribed immediately since the "Golden Era" as advertized by Amazon was in line with what I listen to. I wish Amazon had announced the beginning of the subscription more publicly as I would have joined during the first month in May and received "Pink Floyd: The Wall, " which I really want. Hope that becomes available as a club selection soon.
The Clash: London Calling, is a great album. Listed as one of the top 10 record albums on many audiophiles lists, it certainly lived up to its hype and quality. I had no issue with the pressing.
label: positive
